**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork, in ork run ork-20261125-163301-8662, item S563. Its command `go test -run A|B` was denied as multiple operations. An unquoted `|` makes a compound command, and the read-only allowlist matches one plain command at a time. ork writes focused test commands in several places, and none of them says plainly that each test gets its own command. The UI brief's `## Test run patterns` section (`internal/engine/brief.go:234`) also allows "a pattern with no pipe that the tests share". Besides the UI role, the Base overlays text (`internal/engine/baseoverlay.go:75`) says only "Add `-run NAME` to run one test". The gate prompt and the spec-draft prompt say nothing about it.

The owner chose "text only" (session 8d711f67, 2026-11-25), and S582 and S583 are merged in. Every focused test command ork writes or tells a role to write is one `go -C DIR test -run NAME PKG` command per test, never a `-run` alternation. The change is wording only: ork gets no new code path and does not itself name tests. The tests assert that no `|` appears in any `-run` text ork writes.

Owner decision, 2026-11-25 (adj 581): the rule goes in gate.md and spec-draft.md only.
